entries.problem: The document-level Escape handler always called closeMenu() and toggle.focus(), including when navigation was already closed.
entries.attempt: Guard on aria-expanded before closing/focusing; add Node.js VM interaction regression tests.
entries.evidence: python3 tests/validate_site.py, node --check script.js, node --check tests/test_menu.js, node tests/test_menu.js — all PASS.
entries.root_cause: Escape handler did not distinguish an open menu from a closed menu.
entries.successful_repair: Return early unless Escape is pressed while aria-expanded is true; then close and restore focus.
entries.future_prevention: Keep regression coverage for closed/open Escape, repeated Escape, link selection and outside click.
